summary: On the doorstep: the guest greets the host sourly in close-up, the camera whips back to a two-shot for the host's effusive welcome, then the guest walks past him into the house.
framing: Starts as a close-up of the guest in profile from outside the doorway (street of houses behind), with the door swinging out of frame. At 159-164 a whip pull-back and pan right to a medium two-shot: guest left, host right in the doorway, door frame at both edges. From 261 the street background slides right while the door frame stays put.

notes: Camera: the whip at 159-164 matches timeline.json. Not in timeline.json: from 261 to about 276 the exterior background layer slides right (in steps on frames 261, 263, 265, 267, 269, 271, then smaller steps) while the door frame at both edges and the host stay fixed on screen, so it is a background-layer slide (fake parallax for the guest walking in), not a pan of the whole picture.
